records.part: Fecal Immunochemical Test (FIT) collection kits, mailed to Veterans for colorectal cancer screening, including assembly, mailing, prenotification and follow-up communication
records.quantity: approximately 6,000 FIT collection kits to be mailed annually
records.reason: Polymedco Cancer Diagnostic Products LLC is the sole manufacturer and distributor of the required FIT kits and the only source that can provide FIT kits.

records.part: Existing instrumentation used to analyze FIT samples returned by Veterans
records.reason: The required collection kits have a 14-day inoculated stability and are compatible with the existing instrumentation, OC-Auto Sensor Diana, and OC-Auto Sensor iO.
